name: EU/EEA/Swiss Right of Residence

requirements.blocker_text: EU/EEA/Swiss citizens may enter and reside in Luxembourg freely for up to 90 days.

Staying beyond 90 days requires declaring arrival at the commune within 8 days, then completing a registration certificate within 3 months, on grounds of employment/self-employment, self-sufficiency plus health insurance, or student status.
requirements.fix_path: Register at the local commune within the required deadlines.

evidence_required.document: Valid EU/EEA/Swiss ID card or passport
Proof of employment, self-employment, sufficient resources, or student status

outcome.duration_length: registration certificate valid until further notice, subject to continuing to meet the grounds; EU permanent-residence attestation available after 5 years

sources.title: Guichet.lu -- Staying and/or Working in Luxembourg for More Than 90 Days as an EU Citizen: 8-day arrival declaration, 3-month registration deadline, employment/self-sufficiency/student grounds
Guichet.lu -- Permanent Residence Permit for EU Citizens

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Luxembourg). pr_after_months (60) reflects the EU-citizen-specific permanent residence attestation, distinct from the general lu_permanent_residence.json EU long-term-resident track that non-EU nationals use.
